summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-named identifiers and string-array indirection; at install time it downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13, per-platform zip) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses that freshly downloaded Bun binary to execute the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with rotating string-array obfuscation (character-code arrays, string-array rotator) whose contents cannot be inspected without executing under Bun. The payload is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a React component kit). Executing an opaque, obfuscated bundle under an alternate runtime fetched at preinstall bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners and constitutes install-time execution of attacker-controlled code. The package additionally claims the @servicetitan npm scope, consistent with scope impersonation or a compromised-maintainer publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
